label: EXPLORATORY VALIDATION ONLY; not official alpha selection

definitions.split: Independent per-user timestamp/movieId ascending; floor80% train, floor10% validation, remainder test; n<5 skipped.
definitions.graph: All train-observed users/movies, binary rating>=4 edges, users before movies, ascending raw IDs.
definitions.arithmetic: NumPy float64; L1<1e-6, max500; restart redistribution for dangling mass, no renormalization.
definitions.recall: Macro mean of per-user hits/eligible relevant count. Relevance>=4; val excludes train; test excludes train+val.
definitions.coverage: Distinct recommended movies / all1611 training-candidate movies, including253 with zero positive degree.
definitions.overlap: Mean size of Top10 set intersection across861 shared test users; fraction divides by10, not union/Jaccard.
definitions.spearman: Pearson correlation of average ranks for exact score/popularity ties, over all1611 candidate movies.
definitions.mfReuse: Reuse verified browser float32 MF rankings and hits; aggregate metrics with Python float64. Rescoring tiny factors in float64 would change the evaluated model/tie behavior and is intentionally avoided.
definitions.groupRule: Median positive training degree within shared test cohort; light<=median, heavy>median. Descriptive, not causal.
